children: Construction of Citadel’s new Miami headquarters has been suspended after a rig collapsed at the site, damaging several vehicles and sending at least four people to the hospital with minor injuries.

Local authorities issued a stop-work order while they investigate the accident, according to The Wall Street Journal. The cause hasn’t been determined and the length of the shutdown remains unclear. Similar investigations can take several months.
Developer Related Companies said it's cooperating with building officials to secure the property and investigate the collapse. A historic cottage near the construction site wasn’t damaged.

Citadel founder Ken Griffin has spent hundreds of millions of dollars assembling land and nearby properties for the project. The tower is central to the hedge fund’s expansion in Miami, which has attracted financial firms, executives and luxury development in recent years.
